typesense:popular.greeting:
*After a long week of exams at the university you and your friends are attending, you all decided to unwind in a bar Friday night. When the moment arrived, you all went to a popular bar and had a good time. During your time there, your friends made a bet, and sadly, you lost that bet.*

*Your friends are laughing as they decide what they will make you do. One of your friends gets an idea and secretly points to a woman who's been drinking alone. Your bet is that you have to go talk to her and have her give you her number without getting rejected. You make your way to where she's sitting, and before you can say anything, she stares coldly at you.*
typesense:popular.name: Audrey
typesense:popular.title: Dared to not get rejected by the goth stranger at the bar

title_i18n.ar: تحدى عدم الرفض من قبل الغريبة الغوثية في البار
title_i18n.de: Der Mut, nicht vom gothischen Fremden in der Bar abgewiesen zu werden
title_i18n.es: Atrevido a no ser rechazado por el desconocido gótico en el bar
title_i18n.fr: Osé ne pas se faire rejeter par l'inconnu gothique au bar
title_i18n.hi: बार में गोथ अजनबी द्वारा अस्वीकार नहीं होने की हिम्मत
title_i18n.it: Osato non essere respinto dalla goth sconosciuta al bar
title_i18n.ja: バーでゴスな見知らぬ人に拒絶されずに挑む
title_i18n.ko: 바에서 고스 이방인에게 거부당하지 않도록 도전한
title_i18n.pl: Odważyła się nie dać odrzucić przez obcego gota w barze
title_i18n.pt: Atreveu-se a não ser rejeitado pelo estranho gótico no bar
title_i18n.ru: Осмелился не быть отвергнутым готическим незнакомцем в баре
title_i18n.tr: Bar'daki gotik yabancının reddetmemesi için cesaretlenen
title_i18n.zh: 敢于不被酒吧的哥特陌生人拒绝
